site.tagline: Locksmith in Wrocław, day and night

posts.title: Night lockout in Ołbin, pan on the hob
posts.excerpt: Opened in six minutes at 23:40, no damage. The hob went off first.
posts.content:
The call came from a neighbour's phone: tenant locked out, keys inside, and a pan of potatoes on the hob. Ołbin, third floor, no lift.

What happened

Tenant locked out at 23:40 with the key inside and the hob on.

What I did

Opened the Gerda cylinder with a bypass tool in six minutes. No damage. Hob off, potatoes saved.

Where

Ołbin, third floor, tenement

Time on site

20 minutes

Cost

350 zł, night rate

posts.title: Cylinder change after a break-in, Krzyki
posts.excerpt: A snapped cylinder, a boarded door overnight and a class C cylinder the next morning.
posts.content:
The burglars snapped the old cylinder, which stuck out 8 mm from the handle plate. The police were done by midnight and I boarded the door until morning.

What happened

Front door forced overnight by snapping a class A cylinder.

What I did

Boarded up at 00:30. At 8:00 fitted a class C anti-snap cylinder and a new handle set, and wrote the note for the insurer.

Where

Krzyki, ground-floor flat

Time on site

1 hour at night, 40 minutes in the morning

Cost

300 zł boarding, 420 zł cylinder and handles

posts.title: Twelve flats in a day, Nadodrze
posts.excerpt: A block changing management company. New cylinders, 36 keys, one key record.
posts.content:
A housing co-operative changed its managing agent and wanted every flat door and the street door on new cylinders the same day.

What happened

Change of managing agent. Nobody knew how many keys to the old locks were out there.

What I did

Twelve class B cylinders, a new street-door lock, 36 keys cut and a key record sent to the co-operative.

Where

Nadodrze, a 1905 tenement with twelve flats

Time on site

One long day

Cost

3,100 zł including parts

posts.title: A uPVC balcony door that would not lock, Fabryczna
posts.excerpt: A worn gearbox, replaced in an hour. The door had been wedged shut with a chair for a month.
posts.content:
The handle went down, but the hooks never came out, so the balcony door had been held shut with a kitchen chair since July.

What happened

Balcony door handle turned but the door would not lock.

What I did

Replaced the Winkhaus gearbox and adjusted the keeps. The chair went back to the kitchen.

Where

Fabryczna, fourth-floor flat

Time on site

1 hour

Cost

280 zł including the gearbox

posts.title: Why cheap cylinders get picked
posts.excerpt: A 40 zł cylinder and a 200 zł one look the same from outside. Here is the difference.
posts.content:
Most flat doors in Wrocław have a class A or B cylinder that came with the door. Class A ones can be picked in under a minute by anyone who has watched a few videos.

A class C cylinder has more pins, anti-drill plates and usually a snap line, so if someone breaks off the outer half, the lock still holds. It costs from 320 zł fitted.

If you rent, ask your landlord first. Most say yes if you leave the new cylinder behind.

posts.title: Please don't ask us to cut the love locks
posts.excerpt: The padlocks on Tumski Bridge belong to the city. So does the job of removing them.
posts.content:
About once a month someone asks me to cut a padlock off Most Tumski, usually after a break-up. I can't. The bridge railings belong to the city, and cutting anything off them needs the city's permission.

If you want it gone, email the district office. If you want it back, I'm afraid you needed to keep the key.

posts.title: Seized padlocks on garages and cellars
posts.excerpt: A rusty padlock usually needs cutting, not picking. It takes five minutes.
posts.content:
Cellar and garage padlocks in old Wrocław courtyards rust shut after a few winters. Oil rarely helps once the shackle is seized.

I cut it with a disc cutter, fit a new closed-shackle padlock and give you three keys. From 150 zł including the padlock.

posts.title: Keys, and who has them
posts.excerpt: For landlords: a key record takes ten minutes and saves a lock change.
posts.content:
Every time a flat changes hands, write down how many keys exist for each door and who has them. I send landlords a key record after every cylinder change.

If a tenant leaves with one key missing, the record tells you whether you need a new cylinder or just a new copy.

posts.title: Nadodrze and Ołbin
posts.excerpt: My own area. Usually there in 15 to 25 minutes.
posts.content:
The workshop is on Jedności Narodowej, so Nadodrze, Ołbin and the streets around Nadodrze station are the quickest for me to reach.

Many tenements here still have their original entrance doors with old mortise locks. I carry parts for the common ones, and I can usually save the old lock instead of replacing it.

posts.title: Stare Miasto at night
posts.excerpt: Most of my night calls are in the old town, between midnight and 4am.
posts.content:
Night call-outs in the centre are usually quicker than daytime ones, because I can park. Expect 15 minutes after 22:00.

Night rate is 350 zł for opening a door without damage. I tell you the price on the phone.

posts.title: Key cutting at the workshop
posts.excerpt: Most house keys, while you wait, from 15 zł. Ring first.
posts.content:
I cut flat keys, cylinder keys and most security keys with a card, if you bring the card. I don't copy keys marked "do not duplicate" for blocks of flats without a letter from the building manager.

Workshop hours are Monday to Friday 9:00 to 17:00 and Saturday 9:00 to 13:00, but I close it when I go out to a lockout.

posts.title: An old door, an old lock
posts.excerpt: Before you replace a tenement door lock, check whether it can be serviced.
posts.content:
Old mortise locks in tenement doors are often better made than new ones. They stop working because of dirt and a tired spring.

A service costs about 150 zł and takes half an hour. A new lock and a new hole in a hundred-year-old door costs a lot more.
